biography: Roberto Lacombe, a name whispered with a mix of admiration and exasperation in Brazilian motorsport circles, hails from the dusty karting tracks of Ribeirão Preto. Growing up amidst sugarcane fields, his first taste of speed came from tinkering with his grandfather's beat-up Gol. That early experience fueled a passion that led him to dominate local karting, catching the eye of Gol Classic B team manager, Ricardo Alves. His debut season was a revelation, showcasing raw talent and fearless overtaking. However, inconsistency plagued him; a stunning victory at Interlagos would be followed by a crash in the next race. He has since moved to the Passat Classic FL team hoping for a fresh start. Currently, Lacombe finds himself at a crossroads, his peak talent battling his erratic nature.
drivingStyle: Lacombe's driving style is a high-risk, high-reward affair. He's known for his late-braking maneuvers and aggressive corner entries, often pushing the limits of his car and tires. While this approach yields spectacular overtakes and blistering lap times, it also leads to costly errors. Tire management is not his forte; he prefers to attack relentlessly, burning through rubber in his pursuit of victory. Under pressure, he can either rise to the occasion with a heroic drive or crumble under the weight of expectations.

rivalries.name: Isabela Vargas
rivalries.reason: A fierce competitor on the track, their rivalry started when Vargas accused Lacombe of deliberately blocking her during qualifying at Curitiba. Their on-track battles are always intense and often result in collisions.

rivalries.name: Mateus Oliveira
rivalries.reason: Oliveira is a calculating and consistent driver, a stark contrast to Lacombe's aggressive style. Their clashes stem from differing philosophies, with Oliveira often criticizing Lacombe's recklessness.

rivalries.name: Ricardo Esteves
rivalries.reason: Esteves and Lacombe were once teammates but their friendship fractured during a controversial team order incident at Goiânia, where Lacombe refused to yield position to Esteves.

quirks: Always wears the same pair of lucky socks, regardless of the weather.
Before each race, he listens to a specific Brazilian samba song on repeat.
Refuses to have his car washed during a race weekend, believing it washes away his luck.
famousQuote: Sometimes, you gotta risk it all to win it all. Second place is just the first loser.
careerHighlight: Winning the Interlagos Grand Prix in 2020 after starting from the back of the grid, overcoming a penalty and multiple crashes to take a spectacular victory in front of his home crowd.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead on the last lap of the 2021 Curitiba Grand Prix after a collision with Isabela Vargas, costing him a potential championship title.
